name: com.fahril.autocollider
description: Generate, optimize and edit colliders for one or many objects: fitted primitives, convex hulls, convex decomposition, simplified mesh colliders, painted and per-bone colliders, in-scene collider editing, a Collider Doctor, and a Collider Group component that handles all of an object's colliders (and their collision events) as one.

samples.description: Demo scene with props to generate, a skinned arm, a LOD object, deliberate collider mistakes for the Doctor, and collision events in Play mode (materials use URP).
